bibliographic.title: The Museum
bibliographic.author: Andreas Jörgensen
bibliographic.description:
After a long, boring day, you decide to take a well-deserved, relaxing trip to the museum, but going there might get you more than you bargained for.

Made for TIGsource's Commonplace Book Competition 2008.

links.title: Windows Package
links.desc: The package, intended for use on Windows, includes the story file and Windows Glulxe interpreter. Extract the pack into a folder and run START THE MUSEUM.BAT to play.

links.title: Soundtrack
links.desc: Beware of the Mummy - Marius Schneider
